vBRIEFInfo.description: Follow-up to #2083: add branch-coverage tests and restore the vitest branches threshold to 85

plan.title: Restore vitest branch-coverage threshold to 85 (post-#2083 follow-up)

narratives.Description: The parity-harness teardown (#2083) and the earlier Python removal (#1860) shifted the branch denominator, leaving the vitest branches threshold temporarily lowered (85 -> 84.9 -> 84.85). This follow-up adds targeted branch tests to push real coverage back over 85 and restores the threshold to the original 85.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Identify the cheapest uncovered branches (packs-slice.ts had ~72 uncovered).
- Add a focused packs-slice-branches.test.ts covering the pure helpers, slice filtering, formatting, discoverPacks edge cases, and the CLI/main flag paths.
- Restore the vitest.config.ts branches threshold to 85.
- Confirm task check green with the restored bar.
narratives.UserStory: As a deft maintainer, I want the branch-coverage gate back at 85 so the temporary denominator-shift relief from #1860/#2083 does not become permanent drift.

items.title: Given the lowered branch threshold, when targeted branch tests land, then real branch coverage measures at or above 85%.
Given coverage is restored, when vitest.config.ts is updated, then the branches threshold reads 85 and task check passes.

narrative.Acceptance: vitest.config.ts branches threshold = 85; task check exits 0.

references.title: Issue #2083: parity harness teardown (parent of this coverage follow-up)
